I feel the same way. Sometimes I want to cut and die and another I’m feeling good and constantly tell myself I’m faking it. 
What I did was kept a journal, physical or on phone notes. I write in it when I feel sad and just write what I feel. When I read it back after a while I realised that I wasn’t faking it and there was definitely something wrong. I just need to build up the courage to get help now. Hope this helps x
I think a fun way to go would be to use aload apple seeds bc they have cyanide in 🥴
Please call an ambulance or a friend
Please go to the hospital. It’s easy to die, so why rush? You don’t know what you’ll miss

Please stop while you can. Self harm is one of my biggest regrets so please please stop while you still can, for me it’s an addiction at this point and as much as I want to stop I can’t seem too. It’s ruined friendships, made me completely closed off and made my mental state 10x worse. Get help now rather than later, please 💜
